versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.

indie-game-ost-pack 0.1.1

- Added detailed documentation in SKILL.md covering input requirements, pack scope, routing adjacent needs, and delivery workflow.
- Clarified soundtrack planning, approval, and billing steps for custom indie game music packs.
- Outlined recovery procedures for lost create responses and task IDs.
- Specified strict use of bundled script for all Beatra operations, including automatic safe updates and update control commands.
- Included comprehensive references for workflow, installation, tasks, billing, diagnostics, and uninstallation.
